summary: One POST form with the fields login_user and pass_user, written out in the templates of the mailcow UI. Current releases have three login pages with the same form: / for mailbox users, /admin and /domainadmin.

sources.title: mailcow 2026-09a mailbox user login template, served on / by data/web/index.php
mailcow 2026-09a administrator page script: data/web/admin/index.php renders the admin template; data/web/index.php and data/web/domainadmin/index.php do the same for the other two
mailcow 2026-09a two-factor confirmation dialog, shown on the same page after the password is accepted. The script that opens it and selects an authenticator is in templates/base.twig lines 246-292.

selectors.locator: lines 39 (form) and 44 (input); the same input is at user-template line 51 and domainadmin-template line 44
selectors.note: On the mailbox user page the type is text or email depending on the request, so the selector does not rely on it.
A button beside the field switches the type to text while the user wants to see the password.
The value attribute is a fixed word in the template; the visible label is translated.

staysInteractive.note: After the password a dialog on the same page asks for the second factor. With more than one authenticator the user first picks one from a list, which the format's challenge cannot do, so no challenge is defined.
WebAuthn and Yubico OTP are tabs of the same dialog, and a FIDO2 link is shown under the form.
The mailbox user page can show an identity-provider button and can hide the form when single sign-on is forced.

schemaGaps: The authenticator-code dialog needs a click on the chosen authenticator before its code field is usable (it opens by itself only when the account has exactly one authenticator and no other method). A TOTP challenge has a code selector and a submit selector only, no preceding click and no condition on the dialog being open.
The path gate names paths at the host root, and the format has no installation-relative gate. An installation under a sub-path is not covered. Nothing is filled there.
notes: The form, the two ids and names and the submit button are the same at 2022-12, 2023-12a and 2024-08a, where one page on / serves every role, and at 2025-03 and 2025-09 with the three pages (read at those tags on 2026-10-12). The path gate lists /, /admin and /domainadmin with and without a trailing slash; whether the web server keeps or adds the slash was not determined. The saved credential must belong to the role of the page that is opened.
